scope: Exploratory rank8 seed42 Glaive held-out matched pair, not BFCL
metric: Strict order-invariant JSON exact match, preserving duplicate calls and types
bootstrap: 1000 paired case resamples, RNG seed42, lexicographic IDs, percentile indices25/975
limitations: Exploratory seed42 only; paired case uncertainty is conditional on the fitted models, not training-seed uncertainty or a fixed-step-budget causal effect. Both use10k positives and two-epoch requests, but negatives increase total examples and optimizer steps. No frozen baseline held-out result exists, so no baseline delta is claimed. Glaive is the authorized synthetic fallback, not xLAM; agent review found semantic near-duplicates across splits and negative-label noise, so these high scores do not establish uncontaminated generalization. Agent review is not human-gold validation. No model/checker reruns or metric/training-data changes.
